method: Buy each manager's AI-stock basket at the CLOSE OF ITS 13F FILING DATE (not quarter end — a 13F is public ~45 days late, so the filing-date price is the first price a real person could actually pay), weighted as filed, hold until the next filing, repeat. Prices: Stooq daily closes. Holdings: SEC EDGAR primary filings. Past results do not predict future returns; not investment advice.
